entities.name: Banath'thur
entities.description: A criminal demon of Alara wanted for mass destruction and soul corruption.

entities.name: Vithians
entities.description: Humans of Grixis who imprisoned him and later became his minions.

entities.name: Nacatl pride
entities.description: A pride turned into his minions.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event that merged regions and broke his bindings.

entities.name: Revin Skoros
entities.description: A human wizard tempted by Banath'thur and turned one of the Damned.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard where the Vithian base was brought.

events.summary: Banath'thur was imprisoned by Vithian humans in a vault under their base.
events.quote: Banath'thur was a demon imprisoned by a group of Vithian humans of Grixis.

events.summary: The Conflux broke the base and binding spells, freeing Banath'thur.
events.quote: both damaging the building and the binding spells keeping the demon contained

events.summary: Banath'thur turned the Vithians and a Nacatl pride into minions and slew two Bant angels for their souls.
events.quote: He is known to have slain two of Bant's angels to take their souls and continues to hunt for more.

events.summary: Banath'thur tempted Revin Skoros, who became one of the Damned.
events.quote: This caused Skoros to become one of the Damned, an undead husk who surrendered his soul.

relations.quote: Banath'thur turned the Vithians and a nearby Nacatl pride into his minions
